content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — deploy-induced p99 latency + 5xx spike on inference-gateway (prod-us-west-2). Deploy finished ~17:08 UTC. Pager: @oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: seeing p95 ~1.1s, p99 ~5.8s, 502/504s ~3.9% of traffic. Traffic is real customer requests (not tests). Rolling deploy id = deploy-2026-03-17-1789.
samir: copying logs now. any quick roll forward/rollback plan? can we divert traffic to warm pool?
maya: I'm preparing a rollback to deploy-2026-03-17-1788 (previous). propose canary rollback 10% -> 100% if metrics look good.
sre-jordan: +1 to rollback. also seeing increased connection queue length on gateway pods, many keepalive resets. suspect muxer change in this deploy.
infra-dev: confirmed config diff: muxer.pool_size from 1024 -> 256 in runtime-config (accidental). that matches connection pressure.
observability-bot: current aggregate: p99 latency 5800ms, 5xx rate 3.9%, error burst started ~17:09 UTC, top route: /v1/generate (60% of errors).
oncall-alex: executing rollback now. running command:```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=1788
```
samir: removing new muxer flag on the fly not safe; rollback is fastest. initiating canary -> 10%.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by oncall-alex. Canary at 10%.
observability-bot: Canary metrics (2 minutes): p99 -> 1.2s on canary, cluster p99 still 5.6s. 5xx on canary 0.2%.
maya: ramping canary to 50%.
sre-jordan: after canary success, ramp to 100%.
incident-bot: Rollback to revision 1788 completed (100%).
observability-bot: Post-rollback metrics: p99 260ms, p95 140ms, 5xx rate 0.3%.
product-ops: customer impact summary: error surface affected ~18 customers (mostly API heavy), transient request failures and increased latency ~17:09-17:18 UTC. No long-term data loss.
oncall-alex: immediate mitigation done. creating follow-up: root cause triage, rollback CA, add e2e for muxer config, improve preflight checks.
samir: assigning RCA to samir and infra-dev. will schedule postmortem doc.
maya: notify support + CS with incident summary and ETA for postmortem.
sre-jordan: quick note: add a pre-deploy gate for config diff on muxer.* and keepalive settings.
product-ops: copying summary to customers who reported errors.
incident-bot: Incident resolved — monitoring for regressions. Follow-up checklist created: #incident-1793332222. :white_check_mark:
oncall-alex: thumbs: :thumbsup: thanks team — handing to RCA owners.
